Probability of that map follows from measurable right translation via Measure.isProbabilityMeasure_map, while the Haar instance is Mathlib Measure.isHaarMeasure_map_mul_right (MeasureTheory/Group/Measure.lean lines 867–872). Its final mulVec/dotProduct calculation cancels QᵀQ and proves exactly (Qx)ᵀA_{QOQᵀ}(Qx)=xᵀA_Ox. Signed det O, rather than |det O| or a +1 component restriction, is preserved. In the public proof, hcov explicitly consumes that provider's determinant and quadratic outputs. hAc and hcont establish continuity of the actual determinant-weighted formula including real sqrt; hL1 uses compact support from compactness of the whole group and continuous-function integrability under the actual finite Haar probability. No hidden uniform-in-x bound or exchange of spatial integrals occurs.
